author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Vazquez placed on taxi squad
desc: The Orioles placed Luis Vazquez on their taxi squad.
impact: Vazquez is with Baltimore in Anaheim. He'll be available to be called up if needed.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yaramil Hiraldo (shoulder) to throw live BP this week
desc: Yaramil Hiraldo will throw live batting practice this week.
impact: Hiraldo is continuing to progress on his way back from a shoulder injury. He'll look to get cleared to head on a rehab assignment likely early in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Adley Rutschman (concussion) continues to be monitored
desc: Adley Rutschman is continuing to be monitored.
impact: Rutschman is following post-concussion protocols. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cade Povich (elbow) continuing rehab assignment
desc: Cade Povich is continuing his rehab assignment with Double-A Chesapeake.
impact: Povich threw 43 pitches in his first rehab outing. He'll likely require at least two more rehab starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dean Kremer (quad) continuing rehab assignment
desc: Dean Kremer is continuing his rehab assignment with Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Kremer threw 66 pitches in his first rehab outing. He'll likely require at least two more rehab starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dylan Beavers (oblique) transferring rehab assignment to Triple-A
desc: The Orioles are transferring the rehab assignment of Dylan Beavers to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Beavers is continuing his rehab assignment on Tuesday. He could be activated by the end of June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Felix Bautista (shoulder) to begin bullpen phase of throwing progression
desc: Felix Bautista will begin the bullpen phase of his throwing progression on Tuesday.
impact: Bautista is continuing to progress on the mound. He'll likely require multiple bullpens before he gets cleared to face live hitters.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Nick Kurtz goes yard, drives in three in loss to Angels
desc: Nick Kurtz went 2-for-4 in Sunday's loss to the Angels with a home run, two runs scored, three RBI, and one walk.
impact: Kurtz continues an impactful stretch, getting on base in each of his last 22 contests. The first baseman remains one of the more dynamic options as part of an inconsistent Athletics lineup, carrying a .995 OPS with 19 home runs, 61 RBI, 56 runs scored, and seven stolen bases across 77 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emilio Pagan (hamstring) to begin rehab assignment Thursday
desc: Emilio Pagan will begin a rehab assignment on Thursday.
impact: Pagan threw a successful live batting practice session. He is not expected to require a long rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shohei Ohtani throws bullpen, to start Wednesday
desc: Shohei Ohtani threw a bullpen on Monday ahead of his scheduled start on Wednesday.
impact: It is unclear if Ohtani will be in the lineup on Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trey Mancini elects free agency
desc: Trey Mancini has elected free agency.
impact: Mancini was sent outright by the Angels. He will likely pursue another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Madrigal designated for assignment
desc: The Angels designated INF Nick Madrigal for assignment.
impact: Madrigal loses his spot on the Angels 40-man roster. He will head to waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jorge Soler (oblique) activated from IL
desc: The Angels activated OF Jorge Soler from the 10-day injured list.
impact: Soler returns from a two-week absence recovering from a mild oblique strain. He was slashing .220/.300/.402 with nine home runs and 33 RBI prior to his injury.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Liam Hicks (back) undergoes MRI Monday
desc: Liam Hicks underwent an MRI on Monday.
impact: Hicks landed on the injured list over the weekend. The team is waiting on the results.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Eury Perez (leg) could start Wednesday
desc: Marlins manager Clayton McCullough said Eury Perez could start on Wednesday.
impact: Perez threw 51 pitches in his latest rehab start. The team will see how he feels on Tuesday.
